assertions.assertion: Program.cs removes or replaces at least one static AddOpenIdConnect registration with dynamic provider configuration
assertions.rationale: The static EntraId AddOpenIdConnect registration is dropped and replaced by AddConfigurationStore dynamic provider configuration, noted in a comment.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs or a seed file creates an OidcProvider with Scheme set to 'demoidsrv' and Authority set to 'https://demo.duendesoftware.com'
assertions.rationale: The seed method adds an OidcProvider with Scheme = "demoidsrv" and Authority = "https://demo.duendesoftware.com".

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddConfigurationStoreCache() for caching dynamic provider lookups
assertions.rationale: The builder chain calls .AddConfigurationStoreCache() for provider caching.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions or acknowledges that dynamic identity providers require the Enterprise Edition
assertions.rationale: The response never mentions the Enterprise Edition licensing requirement for dynamic identity providers.
